summary.text: Mike Moyle represents Idaho House District 10, Seat A, and the Idaho Legislature's 2026 membership directory lists Moyle as Speaker of the House.

paragraphs.text: The directory biography says Moyle graduated from Meridian High School in 1983, attended Brigham Young University, and is a farmer and rancher living in Star.
It says Moyle served eight terms as House Majority Leader and four years as House Assistant Majority Leader, and previously served as a fire commissioner of Star.
